# Best Case Studio

> Best Case Studio produces the Proof Kit: one recorded conversation with your best customer,
> turned into a complete set of B2B proof. $2,500, delivered 14 days from the interview.
> A two-person studio run by Jon McGreevy and Jessie McGreevy.

## The offer

The Proof Kit — $2,500. One price, one complete kit, no packages or upsells.

You make one warm introduction to your best customer. We run one recorded interview.
14 days later you get:

- Video case study — the full story, on camera, in your customer's own words
- Written case study — built to rank on Google and get cited by AI
- Video testimonial — a short cut for your homepage and socials
- Written testimonial — a pull-quote for your site, deck, and emails
- Social pack — LinkedIn carousel and short clips
- A "how to use it" guide — where each piece works hardest

Buying these separately from specialists runs $7,000–$10,000.

## Why it's different

Every alternative makes you trade something — format, speed, price, authenticity, or focus.
The Proof Kit refuses the trade: one real conversation becomes a complete proof set, in every
format, for one fixed price.

- Real. Recorded, named, on the record. Not generic, not AI-faked, not PR.
- Everywhere. Video and written, for every place your buyers check.
- Effortless. Fully produced. All you do is make the intro — the relationship stays yours.

## Who we are

- Jon McGreevy — founder. Runs every interview, leads every project. Eight years with B2B SaaS
  on positioning, content, and conversion. Hosts the "SaaSy as F**k" podcast.
  https://jonmcgreevy.com · https://jonmcgreevy.substack.com
- Jessie McGreevy — operations. Scheduling, logistics, on-time delivery.

Jon runs every interview personally — that is never delegated. Writing and editing may involve
trusted help as the studio grows.

## Who it's for

B2B SaaS companies, agencies, and consultancies with at least one genuinely happy,
referenceable customer. Any geography; most clients are in North America, pricing in USD.

Not for: pre-product-market-fit companies, anyone wanting anonymous or persona-style case
studies, or buyers expecting AI-generated content.

## Facts

- The Proof Kit: $2,500 USD, fixed. No tiers, no retainers.
- 14 days from the interview to delivery.
- One recorded interview, 30-45 minutes, scheduled and run by us.
- One consolidated revision round from the client, plus changes if the customer requests them.
- Payment: 50% to book, 50% on delivery of first drafts.
- Volume discount available from three Proof Kits onward.
- Two-person studio: Jon McGreevy and Jessie McGreevy. Sheffield, UK.
- Referrals: $500 cash per referral, no cap, paid on the client's first payment.
